item.title: Volunteer UX review for the Vellivex first-use guide
item.dc:creator: Vellivex Privacy Tools
item.description: Vellivex publishes experimental GPL-3.0 privacy tools. We welcome volunteer usability reviewers to help make the public first-use guide easier to follow. Spend around 10 minutes on the guide. Locate VVault and read the save-and-reopen directions. Tell us where you first hesitated and suggest one clearer line of copy. The written guide is available without an account. Trying a hosted demo is optional and can require an email code. If you try it, use a fictional sample and leave passwords, keys and personal data out of your feedback.
item.content:encoded:
Organization: Vellivex Privacy Tools

Status: searching

Compensation: gratis

Role: UX review

Vellivex publishes experimental GPL-3.0 privacy tools. We welcome volunteer usability reviewers to help make the public first-use guide easier to follow. Spend around 10 minutes on the guide. Locate VVault and read the save-and-reopen directions. Tell us where you first hesitated and suggest one clearer line of copy. The written guide is available without an account. Trying a hosted demo is optional and can require an email code. If you try it, use a fictional sample and leave passwords, keys and personal data out of your feedback.

How to Apply:

  • https://vellivex.com/testing
